A1_contract_proposal.failed_turn: Reject the deficient candidate; after explicit failure settlement a queued request may begin its own turn under its own contract. This does not repair old standing or authorize teaching.

steps: Reject the deficient complete-work Observation without restoring its standing.
Record and settle the failed turn; if any effect is in flight, reconcile/wait before queue release.
Admit the next queued learning request into a new serial turn and its predeclared request-specific contract.
Read permitted original task/work records as needed; do not consume the failed Observation as formal evidence.
Policy judges the current request, activity and allowed actions; request does not itself grant authority or switch activity.
If a permitted Control is chosen and committed, acknowledge its actual effect and process the result before continuing in the same turn.
Under the effective activity, form and validate a new teaching Policy/action candidate; failed or indeterminate Control cannot enable teaching.
Record actual disclosure; a later new-task correct answer is not by itself proof of independent mastery.
